issue.title: artifact-link event store rejects every new link: operation_id reused for different events
issue.description: Discovered by the bob-cli-1z land agent while linking a follow-up task to its proposing bead. Every 'sase artifact link add' in the bob-cli project now fails with: "Error: artifact-link event store is invalid: validation: operation_id `de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c` was reused for different artifact link events". The failing operation_id is identical across retries and across fresh source/target pairs, and 'sase artifact link list' still reads fine, so the duplicate pair already exists in the stored events (pre-existing corruption, possibly from a retried link write around the 2026-09-07 bob-cli-1u<->bob-cli-1x link) and whole-store validation now blocks all appends. Needs investigation of the artifact-link events in the bead store plus either a data repair (dedupe the colliding events) or a sase fix (tolerate/repair idempotent replays), and ideally a guard so one bad historical pair cannot brick all future link writes.

task_type_fields.impact: No agent in this project can record any new artifact link (bead-to-bead related links, task evidence refs), so /sase_new_task's related-link and retired-umbrella flows are broken until the store is repaired.
task_type_fields.location: bob-cli beads store artifact-link events; validated by sase artifact link add (sase 0.17.1)
task_type_fields.repro: From a bob-cli workspace, run: sase artifact link add bead:bob-cli-20 related bead:bob-cli-1z.5 "why" — fails with the operation_id-reuse validation error; retries and different endpoints fail identically while sase artifact link list succeeds.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced 2026-09-20 by the bob-cli-23 land agent (sase 0.17.1, workspace bob-cli_10). 'sase artifact link add bead:bob-cli-24 related bead:bob-cli-v "..."' failed with the same fixed operation_id de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c, on a bead pair that has never been linked before, confirming the collision is in the stored history rather than in the new write. Impact here: the /sase_new_task related-link step could not be completed for the new task bob-cli-24, so the relation had to be recorded as free text in a bead note instead. Still failing 10 days after the original report.

payload.close_reason: Stale task bead swept from triage.
